column1: Update products below. To add a product, insert a table row above the COUPONS & OFFERS section. Keep product IDs unchanged.
Stock: TRUE = available, FALSE = out of stock. Pieces per pack = pack contents. Shots = firing count per item, not pack contents.
Discount value: Percent 10 means 10% off. Fixed 100 means ₹100 off. Existing coupons stay OFF until order limits are confirmed.
Minimum order = smallest qualifying subtotal. Maximum order = largest qualifying subtotal. Both include the entered amount; blank means no limit.
Offers apply to all products. One best offer, no stacking. For Automatic offers leave code blank. No expiry or savings cap. Add rows above SHOP SETTINGS.
MRPs are preserved from your original sheet. Verify them before using crossed-out prices. Keep original screenshot links until direct product images are ready.
Website importer must read TRUE/FALSE stock and inclusive minimum/maximum order limits. Stock is availability only; no quantity tracking.
